delete_library_entry.description: Soft-delete a user library entry by moving it to the bin. Cannot delete shipped (read-only) library entries. The entry can be restored later using restore_bin_entry.

error_shipped.error: Cannot delete shipped library entry 'sphere' in category 'primitives'. Shipped entries are read-only.

error_not_found.error: Library entry 'nonexistent' not found in category 'primitives'. Available entries: sphere, cube

browse_bin.description: List all entries in the library bin, optionally filtered by category.

category.description: Optional category filter. If omitted, lists entries from all categories.

restore_bin_entry.description: Restore a previously deleted library entry from the bin back to its original category. If an entry with the same name exists in the target category, the restored entry is renamed with a numeric suffix.

category.description: Original category of the binned entry

name.description: Name of the binned entry (filename without .3mf extension)

success_with_rename.name: old_shape
success_with_rename.message: Restored 'old_shape' to category 'primitives' as 'old_shape_1' (name conflict resolved)

error_not_found.error: Bin entry 'nonexistent' not found in category 'primitives'.

empty_bin.description: Permanently delete all entries from the library bin, or entries from a specific category. This is irreversible.

category.description: Optional category filter. If omitted, empties the entire bin.

delete_bin_entry.description: Permanently delete a single entry from the library bin. This is irreversible.

name.description: Name of the binned entry (filename without .3mf extension)

error_not_found.error: Bin entry 'old_shape' not found in category 'primitives'.
